newsitem.title: USA: Chevron says Pascagoula refinery operating.
newsitem.headline: Chevron says Pascagoula refinery operating.

text.p: Chevron Corp said its 295,000 barrels per day (bpd) Pascagoula, Mississippi refinery is operational Monday, following a precautionary closure from Friday ahead of Hurricane Danny passing through the region.
Chevron spokesman Steve Renfroe said the refinery was not damaged by the storm. No details were given on when Pascagoula production would return to normal.
Latest information on Chevron offshore Gulf of Mexico production put gas output at 50 percent of the regular 1.2 mmcfd rate, and oil pumpings at 25 percent of the normal 125,000 bpd level.
Chevron spokesman Tom Garcia in New Orleans, said offshore measures were from late Saturday. A further update, which will show production levels closer to normal, was due later Monday, Garcia said.
